reason: The Bank of Ghana names 'First African Remittances, UK' as an affiliate of First African Savings and Loans. The UK register holds a company of that name (02722739), incorporated 1992 as First African Forex Bureau Limited, in financial intermediation, with two directors recorded as Ghanaian nationals resident in Ghana, with a correspondence address in Accra, which applied to strike itself off on 30 May 2019 and was dissolved on 22 October 2019 - two months after the licence was revoked in a notice that cites, among other issues, GHS 5.40m the affiliate had not reimbursed.
decision_note: Strong convergence on name, jurisdiction, business, director residence and timing. No document states the identification, and this project has never resolved an identity on convergence alone. Deciding it 'same' would connect the register record - including named individuals no regulator has named - to a failed institution.
